description: This Java interface defines a Spring Data JPA repository for NotificationRuleEntity, including custom queries for retrieving, checking existence, and deleting notification rules based on tenant ID, name, trigger type, and other criteria.

classes.name: NotificationRuleRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for NotificationRuleEntity with custom query methods for notification rule management.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndSearchText
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of NotificationRuleEntity objects filtered by tenant ID and optional search text.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndRecipientsConfigContaining
methods.description: Checks if any NotificationRuleEntity exists for a tenant with recipients configuration containing a specific string.

methods.name: findAllByTenantIdAndTriggerTypeAndEnabled
methods.description: Finds all notification rules for a tenant with a specific trigger type and enabled status.

methods.name: findInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a notification rule by its ID.

methods.name: findInfosByTenantIdAndSearchText
methods.description: Retrieves paginated info objects for notification rules filtered by tenant ID and optional search text.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all notification rules associated with a specific tenant ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a notification rule by tenant ID and rule name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notification rules for a tenant.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves the external ID associated with an internal notification rule ID.
